statements.chinese: 这些不是给你的。你生气了吗？——我现在生气了。

statements.english: Hey , roomie
statements.chinese: 嘿，室友。

statements.english: Okay , bye
statements.chinese: 好的，再见。

statements.english: Rach
statements.chinese: Rach,

statements.english: There's something important l have to tell you
statements.chinese: 我有件重要的事要告诉你。

statements.english: Are you pregnant ?
statements.chinese: 你怀孕了吗？

statements.english: No , but l'm throwing this shirt away
statements.chinese: 不，但我要把这件衬衫扔掉。

statements.english: l think there was a little misunderstanding before
statements.chinese: 我想之前可能有点小误会。

statements.english: When l said that Chandler and l wanted to live together ..
statements.chinese: 当我说Chandler和我想同居时...

statements.english: ... we meant alone together
statements.chinese: ……我们指的是单独相处。

statements.english: Oh , my God . That's funny . l can't believe l did that
statements.chinese: 天啊，太搞笑了。我都不敢相信自己居然这么做了。

statements.english: No , sweetie . You know what ? This is my fault
statements.chinese: 不，亲爱的。知道吗？这是我的错。

statements.english: l wasn't clear
statements.chinese: 我没听明白。

statements.english: l'm really sorry
statements.chinese: 我真的很抱歉。

statements.english: Listen , you take as much time as you need to move out , okay ?
statements.chinese: 听着，你搬出去需要多久都行，慢慢来，好吗？

statements.english: There's absolutely no rush
statements.chinese: 完全不用着急。

statements.english: Okay
statements.chinese: 好的。

statements.english: Okay
statements.chinese: 好的。

statements.english: Don't you want a cookie ?
statements.chinese: 你不想来块饼干吗？

statements.english: Sure
statements.chinese: 好的。

statements.english: Thanks
statements.chinese: 谢谢。

statements.english: Do you need a tissue ?
statements.chinese: 你需要纸巾吗？

statements.english: - Where did you get these ? - l made them
statements.chinese: - 你从哪儿弄来这些的？ - 我自己做的。

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: Oh , God , they're so yummy !
statements.chinese: 天啊，它们简直太美味了！

statements.english: God . lt's gonna be weird when l come home and you're not here
statements.chinese: 天啊。等我回家发现你不在这里时，感觉会怪怪的。

statements.english: No more Joey and Chan's
statements.chinese: 再没有Joey和Chan的店了。

statements.english: No more J and C's
statements.chinese: 不再有J和C了。

statements.english: Want to go to Joey and Chandler's ?
statements.chinese: 想去Joey和Chandler家吗？

statements.english: Can't . lt's not there
statements.chinese: 不行。它不在那里。

statements.english: Look , I'm just gonna be across the hall , we can still do all the same stuff
statements.chinese: 听着，我就住在走廊对面，咱们还是可以一起做所有事情。

statements.english: Yeah but we won't be able to like get up in the middle of the night
statements.chinese: 是啊，但我们没法半夜随便起床

statements.english: and have those long talks about our feelings and the future
statements.chinese: 并促膝长谈我们的感受与未来。

statements.english: Not once did we do that
statements.chinese: 我们从未那样做过。

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: So l told Rachel that it's just gonna be the two of us
statements.chinese: 所以我告诉Rachel就我们两个人去。

statements.english: Oh , yeah ? Well , how'd she take it ?
statements.chinese: 哦，是吗？那她当时什么反应？

statements.english: Really well
statements.chinese: 非常好。

statements.english: Surprisingly well
statements.chinese: 出人意料地好。

statements.english: She didn't cry . She wasn't angry or sad
statements.chinese: 她没有哭，既不愤怒也不悲伤。

statements.english: And you're upset because you didn't make your best friend cry ?
statements.chinese: 而你生气是因为你没让你最好的朋友哭出来？

statements.english: All l'm asking for is a little emotion
statements.chinese: 我所求的不过是一点真情实感。

is.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

statements.english: ls that too much to ask after six years ?
statements.chinese: 六年过去了，这个要求过分吗？

statements.english: What , are Rachel and l not as close as you guys ?
statements.chinese: 怎么，Rachel和我的关系没你们那么亲近吗？

statements.english: l mean , did we not have as much fun ?
statements.chinese: 我是说，难道我们玩得不够开心吗？

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: Don't l deserve a few tears ?
statements.chinese: 难道我不值得几滴眼泪吗？

statements.english: When we told Joey , he cried his eyes out
statements.chinese: 当我们告诉Joey时，他哭得伤心欲绝。

statements.english: l did not cry my eyes out !
statements.chinese: 我可没把眼睛哭肿！

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问或否定

statements.english: Come on , it's like the end of an era
statements.chinese: 拜托，这简直像一个时代的终结。
